tutorial_hook:r_479b340ccc6c572b.text: ●A battle system fought in teams of 2 units.

tutorial_hook:r_ca4acbac57a2a35e.text: ●A 2-unit group is Tag, a 1-unit group is Single; together a Team.

tutorial_hook:r_77949221bf58f862.text: The main unit and sub unit can be swapped freely.

tutorial_hook:r_70b9c4b9f1f37eff.text: ●A team's passable map terrain (air/ground) is limited to what

tutorial_hook:r_9fcb3754cb1773c7.text: every unit in the team can enter.

tutorial_hook:r_3559d2fad32c2435.text: ●Single Attack　　　Only the main unit attacks.

tutorial_hook:r_f7570547e9f80a64.text: Also applies to an ALL weapon hitting all enemies.

tutorial_hook:r_cbab0f4720e1fcf1.text: And, with an ALL weapon, if the enemy has 2 units,

tutorial_hook:r_0bbe0b4f5364e732.text: ●Center Attack　Sub and Main both attack one enemy unit.

tutorial_hook:r_5dda5198137cb02a.text: The attacked unit counters a Center Attack.

tutorial_hook:r_83ec59afbecdec14.text: ●Wide Attack　　Main hits the enemy's main, Sub hits its sub.

tutorial_hook:r_e20bfd42ad95a3c9.text: Both Main and Sub each counter a Wide Attack.

tutorial_hook:r_0f58a8822381e57f.text: If Main counters with an ALL weapon, Sub does not

tutorial_hook:r_b42ab697149a7c8a.text: ●Map Attack　　Uses a MAP weapon, hitting every team in range.

tutorial_hook:r_4de4fcf3b440baf4.text: ●A challenge worth 1 point, set for every scenario.

tutorial_hook:r_0121a166c715cdff.text: Its condition is shown in the mission objectives.

tutorial_hook:r_30fad37a42bd3ad3.text: ●Difficulty is decided by how many SR Points you've earned.

tutorial_hook:r_80a0b2a84e05d81a.text: E.g. enemies are stronger, raising difficulty.

tutorial_hook:r_4a9ac1dff86506d9.text: ●Retrying after a Game Over forfeits that scenario's SR Point.

tutorial_hook:r_bc8538e6af3d2577.text: Sub Pilots' SP rises the same way.

tutorial_hook:r_924516c8de2b5342.text: However, SP never exceeds its maximum.

tutorial_hook:r_da1174533722333f.text: ●Overall Command 'Mid-map Save' saves map state as 'Suspend Data'.

tutorial_hook:r_fdeb8162976e72c1.text: Select 'Continue' on the title screen, or

tutorial_hook:r_0fadb5c26df92b42.text: use Quick Continue to return to the point of the mid-map save.

tutorial_hook:r_6b15af9a0057cdc8.text: See the manual for how to use Quick Continue.

tutorial_hook:r_15b4a90140e8a33a.text: ●A value only Tag teams have; it represents the team's tension.

tutorial_hook:r_af884a6b11dff121.text: ●Meeting either condition below raises Tag Tension by 1 point.

tutorial_hook:r_ac6fe7838e95647b.text: ●If the pilots of both units making up the team are Ace Pilots,

tutorial_hook:r_77ca87eacd17ad52.text: Tag Tension gets an extra +1 at sortie.

tutorial_hook:r_bf3244994760e535.text: ●Tag Tension maxes out at 2 points, unlocking the following

tutorial_hook:r_02479dc8fe989560.text: Maximum Break　:　A powerful combo attack by Main and Sub

tutorial_hook:r_a2df00f91a9b0a9e.text: Tag Command　　　:　Various effects, such as restoring SP

tutorial_hook:r_48b60d6c48b9b142.text: ●An individual command usable only when Tag Tension is MAX.

tutorial_hook:r_8927e6fb681aa809.text: Using Maximum Break resets Tag Tension to '0'.

tutorial_hook:r_665f01666859013b.text: ●Sub and Main each freely pick a weapon, attacking in succession.

tutorial_hook:r_a571eec59b258d11.text: Sub can choose weapons other than the assist weapon too.

tutorial_hook:r_d4430bf362340b32.text: ●Other systems, e.g. Support Attack, Spirit Commands, are treated

tutorial_hook:r_6ff1323b355593e0.text: the same as a normal attack.

tutorial_hook:r_b7b5625d7cd4282f.text: ●An individual command usable only when Tag Tension is MAX.

tutorial_hook:r_36133ad73a73ef98.text: Using a Tag Command resets Tag Tension to '0'.

tutorial_hook:r_920740a0219c5085.text: ●Tag Command has 4 kinds of effects; select and use one of them.

tutorial_hook:r_3633df5b7b8f47fa.text: PP is the points used for pilot training.

tutorial_hook:r_52dfc56b14b93551.text: Z Chips are points for trades at the D-Trader

tutorial_hook:r_cf41e8828a90cbdb.text: ●Wiping out an enemy team in the ally phase (=downing all units)

tutorial_hook:r_719e897304ec42d4.text: raises the Combo Gauge by 1 (max value is 5).

tutorial_hook:r_d5e0a2317c40d322.text: ●With the Gauge raised, wiping out a team on the next action

tutorial_hook:r_ec2ea17765052401.text: adds another +1; failing to wipe one out subtracts 1 instead.

tutorial_hook:r_f2d4255f1c2f7542.text: The Combo Gauge resets to 0 at the end of the ally phase.

tutorial_hook:r_5d08ad19e2da125b.text: ●For each point of Combo Gauge, allied units gain these bonuses.

tutorial_hook:r_a7246b52782a877e.text: ●The current Combo Gauge is shown in the Overall Command.

tutorial_hook:r_dc8701f6bcb9904f.text: ●A Game Over restarts that map from the beginning.

tutorial_hook:r_d6bdd730f24f66eb.text: Kills, PP, Z Chips, and Power Parts do not carry over.

tutorial_hook:r_41997412868c48c4.text: Also, retrying after a Game Over forfeits that SR Point.

tutorial_hook:r_9e6cf4f389dae55c.text: ●Teams form at intermission; on the map they {c1}cannot split or merge{/c}

tutorial_hook:r_9e0c80ac7e33b459.text: ●A team's Move is the {c1}average of its units' Move, rounded up{/c}

tutorial_hook:r_47d52a2839c71715.text: Sub's attack {c1}uses the assist weapon at x1.0 power{/c}

tutorial_hook:r_55417493fce1d347.text: Sub's attack {c1}uses the assist weapon at x1.2 power{/c}

tutorial_hook:r_8fdf5910927c9591.text: ●Earning it awards a fund bonus of {c1}10000{/c}

tutorial_hook:r_adeb0a29274d3d9b.text: of the SR Points from cleared episodes.

tutorial_hook:r_8f60f6fc86db3107.text: of the SR Points from cleared episodes.

tutorial_hook:r_b1de76a75a253c13.text: Funds for an enemy kill are {c1}x1.2 those on Hard{/c}

tutorial_hook:r_128c35bf3e0e394c.text: ●At sortie, SP is {c1}half of max, rounded up{/c}

tutorial_hook:r_620fedec67706d7d.text: {c1}1. The team's total kill count passes a multiple of 2.{/c}

tutorial_hook:r_9680dcd0fddcfcc7.text: {c1}2. A unit's Main Pilot in the team levels up.{/c}

tutorial_hook:r_2a00f1044ad5cbaa.text: ●For a Maximum Break, {c1}Sub ignores range and move-then restrictions{/c}

tutorial_hook:r_98d15b8cc09bc915.text: ●Damage dealt to the Maximum Break's target {c1}becomes x1.2 normal{/c}

tutorial_hook:r_ac341e7976e88f0b.text: When your next attack wipes out the enemy team (leaves 0 units)

tutorial_hook:r_cfccaa1fbeda124c.text: PP gained on your next kill is doubled.

tutorial_hook:r_a007f9ab9cf048b3.text: Z Chips gained on your next kill are doubled.

tutorial_hook:r_de1213040856c089.text: Restores the Main and Sub Units' Main Pilots' SP by

tutorial_hook:r_3304412ac41f47a6.text: {c1}Final damage dealt to enemy units becomes x1.05 (up to x1.25){/c}

tutorial_hook:r_0c0775e051211840.text: {c1}Funds/Z Chips from downing an enemy become x1.05 (up to x1.25){/c}

tutorial_hook:r_a2afffe1c396f0b3.text: Note: funds/EXP earned before a Game Over on that map {c1}carry over{/c}
